description: Category-level structure and definitions for supporting classification and routing.

categories.description: Issues involving login, account security, password access, or locked profiles.
Problems involving charges, invoices, payment failures, or card authorization issues.
Orders, tracking, route delays, and address changes while a shipment is in progress.
Any request related to returns, replacements, or exchanges of purchased products.
Questions about product capabilities, compatibility, pricing, or available features.
Issues with software, app crashes, device setup, or installation problems.
Subscription upgrades, plan changes, cancellations, or billing schedule adjustments.
Requests related to account security, data retention, privacy policy, and account deletion.
Formal complaints, unresolved support issues, or requests for manager intervention.
Corporate accounts, onboarding, custom proposals, and enterprise integrations.
Coverage, repair eligibility, claim status, and replacement under a guarantee.
Customer feedback, suggestions, and testimonials about product or service quality.
Appointments for onboarding, training, or setup assistance.
Rules, policies, compliance, and legal/regulatory questions.
